# Secure WebView Android Sample

This small sample demonstrates a secure Android `WebView` configuration for a representative mobile security request: **implement secure WebView configuration with HTTPS enforcement and JavaScript disabled by default**.

## Implemented protections

- HTTPS-only loading via `loadTrustedUrl`
- Host allowlisting for `example.com` and `www.example.com`
- JavaScript disabled by default
- DOM storage disabled
- File and content access disabled
- Database storage disabled
- Mixed content blocked
- Safe Browsing enabled on supported Android versions
- Long-click disabled to reduce unwanted interactions
- Navigation restricted in `WebViewClient`
- Cache and history cleared on setup

## Main file

- `app/src/main/java/com/example/securewebview/SecureWebViewActivity.kt`

## Security notes

This is a minimal sample and can be extended with:

- network security config / certificate pinning for API traffic
- cookie policy hardening
- explicit handling for external links
- lifecycle-based data cleanup
- CSP when rendering controlled web content
